betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Constructing a sprawling GregTech mega-base requires hundreds of thousands of building blocks. Constantly running back and forth to your ME system to restock your inventory is an unacceptable waste of industrial uptime. Enter the Mercurial Eye. This esoteric artifact allows you to bypass physical inventory management entirely, manifesting solid architecture directly out of pure energy. It is the ultimate contractor's assistant, designed to turn your grand architectural visions into reality in mere seconds.

Functionally, this acts as a supreme, alchemical builder's wand. It allows you to seamlessly project and place massive walls, floors, and structures by converting EMC directly into the blocks you are targeting.

<< INCOMING SECURE TRANSMISSION... >>
<< SENDER: Pan-Galactic GregTech Corporation >>

"Attention, Chief Engineer! We have released a mandatory, highly-requested firmware update for the Mercurial Eye! Historically, this tool required you to constantly carry, drain, and recharge high-tier Klein Stars just to build a simple factory hall. We found this battery management to be horribly inefficient.

Thanks to our proprietary network-bridging technology, the Mercurial Eye no longer requires a Klein Star! It now features a direct, wireless uplink straight to your personal EMC Network. As long as you have EMC in your Transmutation system, you can build infinitely and seamlessly. Zero battery anxiety. Happy constructing!"
